newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys rapeseed, cottonseed meal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys rapeseed, cottonseed meal.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Friday it bought 8,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal at $159.99 a tonne on a cost and freight basis.
An NLCF offcial said it also bought 8,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal at $154.50 a tonne, C&F, and 7,000 tonnes at $155.00 a tonne, C&F.

The NLCF official said it had originally invited tenders for 15,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal and 15,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal on Wednesday. But it passed on a tender for 7,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal due to high offered prices, he said.
The official said Taihan Sugar Corp won the 8,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal for arrival by March 20 to the western port city of Inchon.

Sunkyong Ltd won 8,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal and Haitai International Inc won 7,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal for shipment February 9-28. Arrival was slated for March 20 to Inchon and for March 10 to Ulsan and Kunsan.
